svg.title: Guide-word scenes: F-02X Longitudinal control, Experimental Mode (end-to-end) under its SC guide words (WP-C-03 §4), phone view
svg.desc: 11 cards for F-02X Longitudinal control, Experimental Mode (end-to-end), one per SC guide word. M01 No Function: H-10, SG-09 (only if D-08 option B); callout: past the stop line on red. M02 Stops Functioning: H-10, SG-09 (only if D-08 option B), covered by M01; callout: past the stop line on red. M03 Unrequested Function: H-04, SG-04 ASIL B; callout: follower closes in. M05 Excessive Function: H-04, SG-04 ASIL B, covered by M03; callout: follower closes in. M06 Partial Function: H-10, SG-09 (only if D-08 option B), covered by M01; callout: past the stop line on red. M07 Functions Early: H-04, SG-04 ASIL B, covered by M03; callout: follower closes in. M08 Functions Late: H-10, SG-09 (only if D-08 option B), covered by M01; callout: past the stop line on red. M09 Function Applies Too Short: H-10, SG-09 (only if D-08 option B), covered by M01; callout: past the stop line on red. M10 Function Applies Too Long: H-04, SG-04 ASIL B, covered by M03; callout: follower closes in. M11 Function is Delayed: H-10, SG-09 (only if D-08 option B), covered by M01; callout: past the stop line on red. M13 Erratic or Intermittent: H-04, SG-04 ASIL B, covered by M03; callout: stop-go at the light.
